definitions.gloss: self-praise, self-admiration, singing one's own praises
definitions.explanation: Praising oneself or one's own work, often with a slightly negative connotation.

examples.japanese: {自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I don't mean to brag, but this dish is excellent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He's always blowing his own horn.

examples.japanese: {自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{上手|じょうず}くいった→うまくいく：21787_umakuiku⟧。
examples.english: I'm not trying to praise myself, but it went well.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) meaning to praise one's own work or accomplishments.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally 'praising one's own painting.' {自画|じが} (one's own painting) + {自賛|じさん} (self-praise). Originally referred to artists writing laudatory inscriptions on their own works.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to praise oneself
- {自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧…: I don't mean to brag, but… (polite preface)
- {自画自賛|じがじさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: I'm not trying to boast, but…

USAGE:
Often used self-deprecatingly when the speaker needs to mention their own achievements. The pattern {自画自賛|じがじさん}になりますが… softens self-praise and is common in both spoken and written Japanese. When used to describe others, it implies they boast too much.
